name: Efficient Recharger
body:
It is a simple matter for you to recharge aethertech devices.

Prerequisite(s): Craft (mechanical) or Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): When you recharge a non-firearm aethertech device using an aetheric capacitor, you may do so as a move action.

Normal: Recharging non-weapon aethertech requires a standard action.
